The model operation shall be verified with a reproducible set of test data in order to ensure correct operation within a pre-defined parameter space of input variables. The model results shall be validated against pre-defined observables in test data and in test campaigns with other models with similar capability. Payload Description: The payload “Camera SpaceMast System” shall be flown in a hosted configuration and can be considered roughly as a block volume with rectangular dimensions. The Deployable Composite Mast itself is flattened and rolled up for stowage, and pushed out of the Stationary Mast Deployment Unit, vice versa for deployment. The mast and therefore the camera box can be retracted and re-deployed multiple times. Actuation of deployment and retraction is driven by an electrical motor and controlled by the Electronics Compartment. Additionally, the overall system features several sensors for monitoring, that are integrated at different locations
